steps.text: 3:49 P.M. \ Clear \ Kazimierz Kawalerielki Alliance, a private open-air loft
...I see you've arrived, Mr. Mob.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Wait. It's you. I saw you back at the arena and you said—
No. That's neither here nor there. Now, don't be so wound up. Take a seat.
Allow me to introduce myself again—please, call me Czarny. I'm one of the rotational managers, currently responsible for a division of the Knights Association.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I'm also an executive of the Mieszko Group Major & Publicity Department, and have had the great fortune to be selected as Divisional Spokesman to the General Chamber of Commerce.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Th—The G.C.C.? Pardon me for my incredible rudeness earlier, Mr. Czarny...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Forego the formality. I'm no critic of your... vernacular, 'Greatmouth Mob.' Or, perhaps, I should be calling you by your real name?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: N-No need...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Haha, I only jest... Now, why don't we take a look outside. Glorious view, isn't it?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: There are some old types that hate this reinforced concrete jungle, the city of seamless day and night. But if you ask me, it is what symbolizes our strides towards civilization.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Our vast forests, grassland expanses, are a priceless part of Kazimierz, true, but our hardy Kazimierz hands built up great skyscrapers where the forests parted. It's something we ought to be proud of.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: It is the only way we find shelter when a Catastrophe strikes, the only way form a front that can stand firm against our foreign enemies. Kazimierz is now prosperous, a rapidly developing place...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Would you agree? Mr. Mob?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Course! You're right on the mark!

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: But Kazimierz's strides are far from over. The road we have to walk is still long.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: For example... Mr. Mob, take your hometown, our 'City of Saplings and Artisans,' Ognisko.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: In the thousand miles around it, how many deprived villages lie? How many troubled lands unafforded the protection of a city?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Y-You really know your stuff, for sure. I was outta there, like, twenty-plus years ago. Can I, uh, ask why you're telling me all this, though?  Truth is, you're kinda bugging me out here...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Your frankness is another part of what draws me to you. I've come to make you an offer, Mr. Mob. One that will take us in joint strides. You've been poached.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ...Me? But I just took a down from the Roar Guards Company...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Please, relax. This contract is confidential, sealed by none other than Mr. Pavel himself. Now, from today on, your employer will be...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: S-So I'm a Mieszko guy now?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: You could put it that way... but let me nitpick it very slightly.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Yeah?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: From now on, you're MY guy, Mr. Anchorman.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hiyaaaaaah—!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Let's stop here for today.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Huh? But I can still...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Overdoing it will undo you! You only just finished recovering. We're all sturdy Kuranta, but no-one torments her body like do!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —Could you help me brainstorm about those Arts I mentioned, then, auntie?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Didn't we already go over this yesterday?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I watched this tape of Leithanian Knights battling last night, and I think I could pull from some parts of it to—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Last night?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: So you were up late again! I've said before, you need to get your rest!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Looks like someone's back in good shape. Them two old cranks can rest easy now.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh! Marcin? Is something up?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Something? Eh... yeah, you might call this something.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: This is, um?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Sponsors who came knocking at your door. Thirteen, in all. And there's some pretty high ranked corps looking for you...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Whoaahh. Glorious Shield's the weapons manufacturer, right... so even companies like these are into keeping competition knights?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Oh, they're all Knightclub invitations. They put the numbers there to make you gasp. They're looking to make you a fine puppet, that's all.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria! You wouldn't let these capitalists lead you by the nose, would you?! Remember your sister here can outbid these and then some, anyway!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Wait... I'm not falling for anything! Just, auntie, you spending money on me like that makes me feel kind of bad...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Money, my high-heeled foot. If I want to spend it, I'll spend it. I didn't buy this land by agonizing about it, I'll have you know.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Is that why the 'gardens' here are just 'fields' now...)

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Hah hah hah... fair to you, I know you turned every last one of them down. Made a fine family out of nothing but your prize money and a few years of retirement. Hats off.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: That said, I'm only here to hand these papers over. Saves Młynar the hassle. Rest of it's up to you two alone. Think it over and if you're okay, come relax over at the bar sometime.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Well... what do you say? Maria?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I've said before, but I don't want our family crest to become a corporate logo... and I know I can't stand toe-to-toe with the rest of them, either. Not as I am right now.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...You're going to press on?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Mm-hm. This isn't just about the money.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: When I think of 'Nearl,' the name my grandpa and my parents protected all their lives, I can't imagine it was all just for the numbers and lines of the stock exchange.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria... Alright, it sounds like I'll be throwing all of these away, then.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: If we're going to make the cut for the Major, we need to get a lot more points, fast—that's the biggest hurdle we face, as independent knights without a Knightclub to hide in.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Remember Szewczyk? Poor man, taken for a ride by his own sponsor. And yet he built up the points to rival nearly an entire team, just on sprint races, and duels alone.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Meanwhile, you had the Knightclubs all wrangling the rules for point transfers, arranging it so their trump cards didn't even need to fight the preselections...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: So I'll have to get past all of those Knightclub teams, soon enough...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That's right. That's why we're going to have to take some special measures... if we're not wasting a single qualifier, we only have so many options.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Such as—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Welcommme, one and allllll, to the Fireblade Arena—!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Fifteen teams! Fifteen knights!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Today's match is a one-and-done! We'll see plundering! Crazy battles! Tight escapes and desperate chases! Welcome to the third largest arena in Kazimierz, manmade to unleash the deathmatch within every knight!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What's that? You say one match only earns you one point!? Where does THAT happen!?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Not here, not now! In this match, any valid attack against a fellow knight means a valid score, and that means points! Points, for fat stacks of cash!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: But who cares if a bunch of point-grabbers play a game!? No, I know! I know what it is you all really wanna see—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: You wanna watch the heroes fall! You wanna watch the great stars crash to the ground! Thaaaat's right! This season's melee matches have a new rule in the mix, the 'Points Off' clause! You hear that, knights? Risk and reward in one!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Where's the spice when your points never drop?! In this match, we're following the 'Predator System!' Let's keep it simple, sister: when someone goes up one, someone else is goin' down one!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Oh, yeah! Believe it, I'm scrapping to see what the do-it-alls do! Our rising stars, swallowed up! It's unprecedented, folks! A match to flip the rankings head to toe!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Thought you could qualify for the Major by wining it up in a bubble bath?! You'd better risk it all right here, right now! Get ready to rumble, because the world's watching!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Don't forget, our sponsored drones from Raythean Industries will be broadcasting every knight's viewpoint non-stop! Our eight registered Knights Association referees won't miss a single detail!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Now, the knights are making their final checks, the crew are fitting their armor with the sensory chips! How many stars will be born today, and how many are gonna eat dirt and taste crushing defeat?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: We can only wait—for the knights—to enterrrrrr—!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: What the hell? This guy again? Isn't he supposed to keep to Roar Guards territory?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Guess he found his own rising star, now.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Nah... 'Points Off?' They ever have a 'Points Off' in the melees before?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: And they announced this all-new system right before the match started. What, they can just do that?!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Didn't bet on the Association being all this capricious, did we... and it doesn't bode well.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Looks like all fifteen knights are readied at their places! Once the crew are out of the way, the match will officially begin!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: A full sixty minutes of battle! Unless every knight is down for the count, this battle goes to the very last second!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Even if your points for this season take a sub-zero dive, you'll still be in the game! Wanna see backs against walls? Last-gasp attacks? You're in the right place, folks!
Hey, Maria Nearl.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —Who're you?
Mmm... just one of your fans.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Alright—! All fifteen knights are signalling ready!

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Let's make it quick. The moment the Brassrust Knight healed up, Ashley—my Ashley—sent him straight back to the hospital. Man, the Ingras have been down on their luck for weeks now.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: I declare—

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Now, Ashley took me right to the playoffs, so I've been a little panicked. Thought I'd try and make up a few points here. But I didn't think I'd find you too, young Nearl.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: —Why don't we go for a little tête-à-tête?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: A what?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: —Let the Fireblade Melee—begiiiiiiiiinnnnn—!
